items.description: A traditional South Indian herbal coffee made with dry ginger (sukku) and coriander seeds (malli), offering a warm, earthy, and slightly spicy flavor. Caffeine-free and soothing, it’s perfect for digestion and wellness!

items.description: A traditional South Indian coffee sweetened with karupatti (palm jaggery) instead of sugar, giving it a rich, deep caramel-like sweetness. Smooth, bold, and naturally flavorful!

items.description: Smooth and creamy with that nostalgic, café-style instant coffee taste. Simple. Classic. Comforting.

items.description: A bold, roasted blend that’s slightly deeper than Nescafe. Great if you like a little more kick in your coffee.
